description: Change who a feedback item is assigned to, its priority or its due date in layernote. The assignee is someone on the project (list_people shows who), by name or email; they get the usual notification. Use "none" to take an assignment, priority or due date away. For the status use set_feedback_status.

assignee.description: Name or email from list_people, or "none"

priority.description: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH or CRITICAL, or NONE

project.description: The project, by name or id from list_projects. Only needed when the token reaches several projects

name: update_feedback
title: Assign a feedback item, or set its priority or due date
